tools.name: health-check
tools.description: Internal health check. Verifies MTProto connectivity and reports link status.

tools.name: auth-status
tools.description: Check the Telegram connection status: whether the account is linked, who is signed in, and whether real-time event forwarding is active.

tools.name: auth-send-code
tools.description: Step 1 of linking a Telegram account: request a login code for the given phone number. Telegram sends the code to the user's Telegram app (or SMS). Then call auth-sign-in with the code the user provides. If the account has 2FA enabled, auth-sign-in will also ask for the password.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number in international format, e.g. "+34612345678"

tools.name: auth-sign-in
tools.description: Step 2 of linking a Telegram account: complete sign-in with the code the user received (from auth-send-code). If the account has two-factor authentication enabled, pass the 2FA password too. On success the session is persisted and the account is linked.

code.description: The login code the user received in Telegram (or by SMS)

password.description: Two-factor authentication password (only if the account has 2FA enabled)

tools.name: auth-disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect the linked Telegram account: logs out from Telegram (invalidating the session on Telegram's side), wipes the persisted session, and stops real-time event forwarding.

tools.name: list-chats
tools.description: List the user's Telegram conversations (dialogs): private chats, groups, supergroups and channels, most-recent first. Returns chat IDs usable with the other tools.

archived.description: List archived conversations instead of the main list (default: false)

tools.name: get-chat-history
tools.description: Read message history from any Telegram chat (private, group, supergroup or channel). Returns newest-first by default with pagination support.

chat.description: Chat identifier: chat ID from list-chats (e.g. "-1001234567890" or "5612345678"), @username, or t.me link

offsetId.description: Return messages older than this message ID (for pagination — use the oldest ID of the previous page)

minId.description: Return only messages newer than this message ID

fromUser.description: Only messages from this user (@username or user ID)

tools.name: search-messages
tools.description: Search the user's Telegram messages. Two modes: global search across all conversations (default), or scoped search inside one chat (pass `chat`).

chat.description: Optional: limit the search to this chat (chat ID, @username or t.me link). Without it, searches all conversations.

fromUser.description: Only messages from this user (only valid with `chat`)

tools.name: send-message
tools.description: Send a text message to a Telegram chat (private chat, group, supergroup or channel). Supports replying to a specific message and disabling the link preview.

chat.description: Destination: chat ID from list-chats, @username, or t.me link

text.description: Message text (max 4096 characters). Markdown formatting (**bold**, __italic__, `code`) is parsed by default.

parseMarkdown.description: Parse Markdown formatting in the text (default: true). Set false to send raw text.

tools.name: send-media
tools.description: Send a file (image, video, audio or document) to a Telegram chat. Reads the file from a local path inside the container — use /workspace/... for files in the user's workspace volume, or a public HTTPS URL.

chat.description: Destination: chat ID from list-chats, @username, or t.me link

file.description: Local file path (e.g. "/workspace/report.pdf") or public HTTPS URL

caption.description: Optional caption shown with the media (max 1024 characters)

asDocument.description: Send as a plain document instead of auto-detecting image/video/audio type (default: false)

asVoiceNote.description: Send an audio file as a voice note (default: false)

tools.name: download-media
tools.description: Download the media attached to a Telegram message (photo, video, audio, document, sticker...) and save it to a local path. Use /workspace/... to save into the user's workspace so other tools and agents can access the file.

chat.description: Chat where the message lives: chat ID, @username or t.me link

messageId.description: ID of the message with the media (from get-chat-history or an event)

outputPath.description: Local path to save the file (e.g. "/workspace/photo.jpg"). Defaults to /workspace/telegram-media/<messageId>.<ext>

thumb.description: Download only the thumbnail instead of the full media (default: false)

tools.name: edit-message
tools.description: Edit a message sent by the linked account. Telegram only allows editing your own messages (in channels, within 48h; in private chats/groups, within 48h unless the chat has longer edit windows).

chat.description: Chat where the message lives: chat ID, @username or t.me link

messageId.description: ID of the message to edit

tools.name: delete-messages
tools.description: Delete one or more messages in a chat. With revoke=true (default) the messages are deleted for EVERYONE in the chat; with revoke=false they are only deleted for the linked account. Deleting other people's messages requires admin rights in groups/channels.

chat.description: Chat where the messages live: chat ID, @username or t.me link

messageIds.description: IDs of the messages to delete (one or more)

revoke.description: Delete for everyone (default: true). false = only delete for yourself.

tools.name: create-group
tools.description: Create a new Telegram group or channel. kind="group" creates a small group chat with the given members; kind="supergroup" creates a large group; kind="channel" creates a broadcast channel. Returns the new chat's ID for use with the other tools.

title.description: Name of the group or channel

members.description: Usernames or user IDs to add as initial members (@username or numeric ID). Required for kind="group" (at least 1 besides you); optional for supergroups/channels.

tools.name: manage-members
tools.description: Manage members of a Telegram group/supergroup/channel: list members, add (invite) a user, remove/kick a user, or ban/unban a user. Listing requires the account to have access to the member list; kick/ban require admin rights.

chat.description: Group/supergroup/channel: chat ID, @username or t.me link

user.description: Target user: @username or user ID (required for add/remove/ban/unban)

limit.description: For action="list": max members to return (default: 50, max: 200)

tools.name: mark-as-read
tools.description: Mark messages in a Telegram chat as read (clears the unread counter and mention badge).

chat.description: Chat to mark as read: chat ID, @username or t.me link

maxId.description: Mark messages up to this ID as read (default: all current messages)
